subject_template: A pre-approved personal loan for you, {company}
hook: Your strong repayment record and rising salary make you eligible for a pre-approved personal loan at a preferential rate.
cta: Shall I share your pre-approved amount and indicative EMI?
compliance_note: Indicative only; subject to final eligibility and KYC.

subject_template: A higher limit / premium upgrade for your card
hook: Given your spends and excellent score, you qualify for a higher credit limit and a premium travel card.
cta: Would you like me to apply the upgrade?

subject_template: A top-up on your home loan, {company}
hook: Your home loan is on track with healthy equity — a top-up can fund renovation at home-loan rates.
cta: Can I compute your indicative top-up eligibility?

hook: Idle savings after your appraisal could be working harder in a laddered FD + SIP.
cta: Shall we build a simple investment plan together?
compliance_note: Investments subject to market risk; suitability assessment applies.

subject_template: Is your cover keeping up with your income?
hook: As income rises, a term/health top-up keeps your family's protection aligned.
cta: Can I share a quick top-up quote?
compliance_note: Insurance is a protection product; suitability applies.

subject_template: Cutting the interest on your card balance
hook: Your card balance is revolving at a high rate — converting it to EMI can cut the interest materially.
cta: Shall I show the EMI-conversion savings?
compliance_note: Service recovery; subject to card policy.

subject_template: Let's get your EMIs back on track
hook: If cash flow is tight, a one-time restructuring / step-down can ease your EMIs.
cta: Can we walk through restructuring options this week?
compliance_note: Restructuring subject to policy and credit review.
